The Basidiomycota ( / b ə ˌ s ɪ d i . oʊ m aɪ ˈ k oʊ t ə / ) [ 3 ] are one of two large divisions that, together with the Ascomycota , constitute the subkingdom Dikarya (often referred to as the " higher fungi ") within the kingdom Fungi . Members are known as basidiomycetes . [ 4 ] This division includes: agarics , puffballs , stinkhorns , bracket fungi , other polypores , jelly fungi , boletes , chanterelles , earth stars , smuts , bunts , rusts , mirror yeasts , and Cryptococcus , the human pathogenic yeast.
